answer: Both deps are status:deferred today (desk/drawer/tasks/task-rw-f4-graph-on-sldb-edge-index.md:3; task-rw-f1-output-golden-files.md:3) and their outputs—tests/test_output_goldens.py and tests/fixtures/golden/—do not exist. Prereqs unverified.

title is semantics.title in the KGDB branch (snapshot.py:142); the simple id-branch stores the raw node and the CLI derives the label via node['label'] or node['title'] or id (cli/main.py:367). So Node.label must encode both shapes.

Reader missing-file text is pinned by tests/test_graph_cli.py:45 and :240: 'graph snapshot not found: {graph_path}'. The wrap must copy str(exc); no test asserts the GraphMissingCheckError text itself.

checks.py reads provenance_path/provenance_locator/extractor from the edge dict and from its 'metadata' sub-dict, keeping only str values (checks.py:135-139, used at 64-66,117,129). Map Edge fields from those same keys.
Top-level id wins; fall back to identity['node_id'] only when id is absent (snapshot.py:131-136; checks.py:89-93). A dict identity lacking node_id with no id is a missing required key.

Only find_missing_snapshot_targets changes to accept a GraphSnapshot; find_missing_graph_references(root, graph_path) keeps its path signature and calls the new reader, wrapping into GraphMissingCheckError (checks.py:32-36).

Wrong claim: cli/main.py:329 is _graph_reflect, which reads the snapshot directly (326), so checks.py's wrap does not protect it; GraphSnapshotReadError must be caught there or tests/test_graph_cli.py:233-240 fail. Fix: change that except to GraphSnapshotReadError.
No edit needed: test_graph_cli.py asserts only reader messages/exit codes (lines 28,45,240,273) that the plan preserves, and `pytest tests` covers it, so its absence from files: is harmless.
